title: Catalog FilterSelect · فیلتر انتخابی کاتالوگ

contract.valueFlow: Each facet keeps its scalar value and calls onChange with one selected value; listing URL/query behavior remains owned by ListingDiscovery.

preservedBehavior: Keep the existing scalar string value and onChange contract.
Keep one native radio group per facet; do not imply multi-select.
Keep category, size, color, and material query behavior in ListingDiscovery.
Keep Persian RTL labels and existing loading, empty, disabled, keyboard, and Escape behavior.
implementationChanges: Keep the final listing cascade at 44px rows with 20px indicators; those effective values were already present.
Use the Atelier line/200 token for the facet divider and indicator borders, and 10px corners for listing option rows and swatch cells.
Make size options at least 44x44px targets while retaining the 36x36px visible chip inside the label.
Raise the list show-more target to 44px.
Use 12px text for small facet counts and swatch labels; use muted Atelier ink for counts.
limitations: Reference options and swatch values are illustrative and do not represent live catalog data.
Board and clean references are static design artifacts, not captures of the running storefront.
Live application visual inspection is unverified because the browser safety gate blocked local-file preview URLs.
